dialog.close-all-games.open-game-windows.value: Odprta so okna iger. Če zapreš glavno okno, se bodo vsa zaprla in aplikacija se bo končala.

expansion.kingdoms-description.en: Each player has a Kingdom Palace in their colour. Instead of drawing, place it in a city with one of your followers to make it your capital. Once your capital is completed it becomes a kingdom: at the end, it scores 3 points for every completed city touching a field connected to it.
expansion.kingdoms-description.value: Vsak igralec ima Palačo kraljestva v svoji barvi. Namesto da potegneš ploščico, jo lahko postaviš ob mesto z enim od svojih človečkov in ga narediš za svojo prestolnico. Ko je prestolnica dokončana, postane kraljestvo: na koncu igre prinese 3 točke za vsako dokončano mesto, ki se dotika polja, povezanega z njo.

expansion.the-kingdoms-description.en: Each player has a Kingdom Palace in their colour. Instead of drawing, place it in a city with one of your followers to make it your capital. Once your capital is completed it becomes a kingdom: at the end, it scores 3 points for every completed city touching a field connected to it.
expansion.the-kingdoms-description.value: Vsak igralec ima Palačo kraljestva v svoji barvi. Ko je prestolnica dokončana, postane kraljestvo: na koncu igre prinese 3 točke za vsako dokončano mesto, ki se dotika polja, povezanega z njo.

game-setup.create.local-limit-reached-to.en: Maximum {limit} local players allowed | Maximum {limit} local player allowed | Maximum {limit} local players allowed
game-setup.create.local-limit-reached-to.value: Dovoljenih je največ {limit} lokalnih igralcev | Dovoljen je največ {limit} lokalni igralec | Dovoljena sta največ {limit} lokalna igralca | Dovoljeni so največ {limit} lokalni igralci | Dovoljenih je največ {limit} lokalnih igralcev

game-setup.game-flow.keep-building-descr.en: Every turn you must enlarge an occupied city, road or similar feature, or place a meeple on an unoccupied one. If a player does neither, the game ends and everyone loses. Survive to the last tile and everyone wins with a combined team score.
game-setup.game-flow.keep-building-descr.value: V vsaki potezi moraš razširiti zasedeno mesto, cesto ali podobno območje ali postaviti človečka na nezasedeno. Če igralec ne stori ne enega ne drugega, se igra konča in vsi izgubijo. Če zdržite do zadnje ploščice, vsi zmagate s skupnim ekipnim izidom.

game-setup.rules.city-description.en: City is completed when its walls are fully closed.
game-setup.rules.city-description.value: Mesto je dokončano, ko je njegovo obzidje popolnoma zaprto.

game-setup.rules.city-scoring.en: City scores 2 points per tile and per coat of arms. An unfinished city scores only 1 point per tile and per coat of arms at the end of the game.
game-setup.rules.city-scoring.value: Mesto prinese 2 točki za vsako ploščico in vsak grb. Nedokončano mesto ob koncu igre prinese le 1 točko za ploščico in za grb.

game-setup.rules.meteorite-description.en: Placing a tile with a crater causes a meteorite impact: a die roll decides how far the blast reaches, and every meeple and neutral figure standing on the hit tiles is knocked off the board.
game-setup.rules.meteorite-description.value: Polaganje ploščice s kraterjem povzroči udar meteorita: met kocke odloči, kako daleč seže eksplozija, in vsi človečki ter nevtralne figure na zadetih ploščicah so odstranjeni s plošče.

game-setup.rules.monastery-description.en: Monastery is completed when it is surrounded by eight tiles.
game-setup.rules.monastery-description.value: Samostan je dokončan, ko ga obdaja osem ploščic.

game-setup.rules.monastery-scoring.en: Monastery scores 9 points. At the end of the game an unfinished monastery scores 1 point for itself and 1 for each neighbouring tile.
game-setup.rules.monastery-scoring.value: Samostan prinese 9 točk. Ob koncu igre nedokončan samostan prinese 1 točko zase in 1 za vsako sosednjo ploščico.

game-setup.rules.road-description.en: Road is completed when all of its ends are closed (by a crossing, a city, a monastery or a loop).
game-setup.rules.road-description.value: Cesta je dokončana, ko so zaprti vsi njeni konci (s križiščem, mestom, samostanom ali zanko).

game-setup.rules.road-scoring.en: Road scores 1 point per tile. An unfinished road still scores 1 point per tile at the end of the game.
game-setup.rules.road-scoring.value: Cesta prinese 1 točko za vsako ploščico. Nedokončana cesta ob koncu igre prav tako prinese 1 točko za ploščico.

game-setup.rules.shrine-scoring.en: A shrine is scored like a monastery.

game-setup.rules.watchtower-description.en: A meeple on a watchtower tile scores a bonus when its feature is scored: points for each matching thing (coat of arms, monastery, city, road or meeple) on the tiles around the watchtower.
game-setup.rules.watchtower-description.value: Človeček na ploščici s stražnim stolpom ob točkovanju svojega območja dobi bonus: točke za vsak ustrezen element (grb, samostan, mesto, cesto ali človečka) na ploščicah okoli stražnega stolpa.

game-setup.rules.watchtower-disabled.en: No tile with Watchtower is in game.
game-setup.rules.watchtower-disabled.value: Nobena ploščica s stražnim stolpom ni v igri.

game-setup.tiles.start-tile-excluded.en: Starting tile count is set to 0 – restore it to create the game
game-setup.tiles.start-tile-excluded.value: Število začetnih ploščic je nastavljeno na 0 – obnovi ga, da lahko ustvariš igro

game-setup.tiles.supply-tiles.en: In the players' supply, not in the draw pile
game-setup.tiles.supply-tiles.value: V zalogi igralcev, ne na kupu za vlečenje

game-setup.variant.bards-notes-stack.des.en: Advanced variant: Bards' notes stack — every note on a feature adds its bonus (+1 per tile, or per completed city of a field).
game-setup.variant.bards-notes-stack.des.value: Napredna različica: note bardov se seštevajo — vsaka nota na območju doda svoj bonus (+1 za ploščico ali za vsako dokončano mesto travnika).

game-setup.variant.leaderboard-empty.en: No finished co-op games yet — set up your own game and be the first on the board!
game-setup.variant.leaderboard-empty.value: Še ni zaključenih sodelovalnih iger — pripravi svojo igro in bodi prvi na lestvici!

game-setup.variant.leaderboard-loading.en: Loading best setups from the server…

game-setup.variant.leaderboard-online-on.en: Connect to the online server to browse the best co-op setups and scores.
game-setup.variant.leaderboard-online-on.value: Poveži se s spletnim strežnikom, da pregledaš najboljše sodelovalne nastavitve in izide.

game-setup.variant.popular-empty.en: No finished games yet — set up your own game and start the statistics!
game-setup.variant.popular-empty.value: Še ni zaključenih iger — pripravi svojo igro in začni statistiko!

game-setup.variant.popular-online-only.en: Connect to the online server to browse the most-played setups.
game-setup.variant.popular-online-only.value: Poveži se s spletnim strežnikom, da pregledaš najbolj igrane nastavitve.

game-setup.variant.standard-description.en: The classic competitive game — every player scores for themselves and the highest score wins.
game-setup.variant.standard-description.value: Klasična tekmovalna igra — vsak igralec zbira točke zase in zmaga najvišji izid.
